Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 Join the team as a Mid-Level Backend Developer and contribute to building and enhancing backend services using Java and Spring Boot. You’ll work in a microservices-based environment, following an API-first approach to deliver reliable and scalable solutions.
 What You'll Be Doing
Develop and maintain backend components using Java and Spring Boot
Implement REST APIs and support microservices-based solutions
Collaborate with senior engineers, QA, DevOps and Product Owners to deliver features
Support defect analysis, performance tuning and code quality improvements
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint goals
 What You'll Bring Along
BSc/MSc in Computer Science or related field
At least 3-5 years of backend development experience with Java and Spring Boot
Experience with REST APIs and understanding of microservices concepts
Familiarity with relational databases like Oracle DB or MySQL, Gitlab and software development best practices
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and cloud environments is considered an advantage
Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in Agile/Scrum teams
